# Implement m3: Refactor TocTreeprocessor.run
with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find the old run method and replace it
old_run_start = "    def run(self, doc: etree.Element) -> None:"
old_run_end_marker = "        self.md.toc = toc\n"

# Extract everything up to the run method
before_run = content.split(old_run_start)[0]
after_run = content.split("\n" + old_run_end_marker)[1]

new_run = '''    def run(self, doc: etree.Element) -> None:
        # Get a list of id attributes
        used_ids = set()
        for el in doc.iter():
            if "id" in el.attrib:
                used_ids.add(el.attrib["id"])

        toc_tokens = []
        for el in doc.iter():
            if isinstance(el.tag, str) and self.header_rgx.match(el.tag):
                self.set_level(el)

                # Do not override pre-existing ids
                if "id" not in el.attrib:
                    # Get inner HTML using render_inner_html
                    inner_html = render_inner_html(el)
                    # Run postprocessors on the inner HTML
                    processed_html = run_postprocessors(self.md, inner_html)
                    # Unescape before slugifying (R6)
                    innertext = unescape(processed_html)
                    # Use striptags to get plain text without unescaping entities
                    plain_text = striptags(processed_html)
                    # Slugify with unicode support for Unicode-friendly IDs
                    el.attrib["id"] = unique(self.slugify(innertext, self.sep), used_ids)

                level = int(el.tag[-1])
                if level >= self.toc_top and level <= self.toc_bottom:
                    # Get the data-toc-label attribute if present, otherwise use the text
                    data_toc_label = el.attrib.get('data-toc-label')

                    # Get inner HTML for the html field
                    inner_html = render_inner_html(el)
                    # Process through postprocessors
                    processed_html = run_postprocessors(self.md, inner_html)

                    # Generate name using striptags (plain text without entity unescaping)
                    plain_text = striptags(processed_html)

                    # If data-toc-label exists, use it; otherwise use plain_text
                    if data_toc_label:
                        name_value = unescape(striptags(data_toc_label))
                    else:
                        name_value = plain_text

                    # Strip footnote references from name (R2)
                    name_value = re.sub(r'<sup[^>]*class="[^"]*footnote-ref[^"]*"[^>]*>.*?</sup>', '', name_value)

                    toc_tokens.append({
                        'level': level,
                        'id': el.attrib["id"],
                        'name': name_value,
                        'html': processed_html,
                        'data-toc-label': data_toc_label if data_toc_label else ''
                    })

                # Remove the data-toc-label attribute as it is no longer needed
                if 'data-toc-label' in el.attrib:
                    del el.attrib['data-toc-label']

                if self.use_anchors:
                    self.add_anchor(el, el.attrib["id"])
                if self.use_permalinks not in [False, None]:
                    self.add_permalink(el, el.attrib["id"])

        toc_tokens = nest_toc_tokens(toc_tokens)
        div = self.build_toc_div(toc_tokens)
        if self.marker:
            self.replace_marker(doc, div)

        # serialize and attach to markdown instance.
        toc = self.md.serializer(div)
        toc = run_postprocessors(self.md, toc)
        self.md.toc_tokens = toc_tokens
        self.md.toc = toc
'''

content = before_run + new_run + "\n" + after_run

with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("m3 changes written successfully")
